about: The old-design guard's budgets (tests/test_zero_old_design.py, B0, 2026-11-13): per file and per page, today's count of each old marker on origin/main 1b94a50, measured in the browser and with the faces "machine" names. A count may only go down, and its budget follows it down in the same change (the measured layout markers within their slack); a file or page absent from here must be at zero; no budget may rise above tests/old_design_ceiling.json, whose hash tests/old_design/budget.py pins. STRICT lists what a batch has emptied for good (none at B0): a file, a file's lines of one batch ("<file>@B7"), every line of a batch ("*@B1"), a scene, or a shell region of a scene or of every scene ("*@topbar"). B24 deletes the budgets: then everything is strict.

unreached./login/pin/forgot/: status 302: a GET is sent back to /login/pin/ (the view acts on a POST only; its form is on /login/pin/, measured there)
